reviews.review_title: Great Game And A Fun Game!
reviews.review_description: when i started playing poc when it was in private applab its was really fun but after the game released servers were full of kids and playing with them is worth playing but after days come by i become mod in this game a very fun game with any events and some gamemodes hopefully there's more gamemodes so even if you play it its way fun but ill never get bored of this game!

reviews.review_title: Fun game but not the funniest.
reviews.review_description: My favorite game personally is Plates of Fate and this game is almost like that. The problem is that there is way to little challenges. If there more challenges that involve the players stats like speed, jump height, and health then I would've put 5 stars instead of 4 but for now I'll keep it at 4.
Very fun game with a variety of game modes so you never get bored!

This game is made by the laziest developers ever. The entire game is made by Claude (including the models) lmao.

developer_response.body: Just to clarify, the 3D models in the game were created entirely by me using 3D modeling software. They were not generated by Claude or any other AI. I understand that everyone is entitled to their own opinion about the game, but I would appreciate it if criticism was based on accurate information rather than assumptions.
